name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for home maintenance for an elderly family member?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for home maintenance for an elderly family member?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for senior home maintenance, look for professionals with experience in accessibility modifications and senior safety. Check for proper licensing and insurance. Request references and review past projects, especially those involving similar work. A reliable contractor should provide a detailed written estimate, communicate clearly, and be transparent about their process. Prioritize those who are patient, understanding, and respectful of the homeowner's needs and schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with experience in senior home modifications, good references, clear communication, and a detailed written estimate.
